purpose: Separate multi-valued immutable research-publication evidence from the one publication currently selected for non-cohort dispatch/execution. Retaining an alternate publication is not quarantine, rejection, truth downgrade or deletion.

legacy_aliases.quarantined_publication_ids: compatibility subset of retained non-operational heads; never interpreted as rejected research evidence

interaction_budget.parallel_selection: Reuse the explicit parallel intake and exact-set synthesis with any references actually performed; no fixed reference count, method sequence, extra heartbeat or polling.

current_reference_rule: The selected synthesis must equal the exact-current reference snapshot returned for its immutable intake. Added references require a new complete synthesis and an explicit resolution update; old records remain historical evidence and are never selected by timestamp.
